sources.title: Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct-GGUF · Models
sources.snippet: For Qwen2.5, we release a number of base language models and instruction-tuned language models ranging from 0.5 to 72 billion parameters. Qwen2.5 brings the following improvements upon Qwen2: Significantly more knowledge and has greatly improved capabilities in coding and mathematics, thanks to our specialized expert models in these domains.

sources.title: Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct-GGUF: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases ...
sources.snippet: Download the base Qwen2.5-.5B-Instruct model from Hugging Face, fine-tune it using a framework like transformers or axolotl, then quantize to GGUF for deployment. Q: Does this model generate factually accurate information? A: The model attempts to provide accurate information but produces confident-sounding incorrect statements (hallucinations).
